notes: Capacity depends on launch energy C3. Only Atlas V 411 has a verified real data point here (what it actually launched for OSIRIS-REx).
For more points, use NASA Launch Services Program Launch Vehicle Performance Website: https://elvperf.ksc.nasa.gov/ (Performance Query).
cost_musd for Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy are NASA's total launch costs for specific missions, which include other mission related costs.

capacity_points.note: Actually launched OSIRIS-REx (2,105 kg) at C3 29.29678 km2/s2. This is a lower bound of capacity, not the maximum.
